summary.text: Amanda Mogoi is the Democratic candidate for the Kansas House of Representatives, District 100, in the November 3, 2026 general election; she is a family nurse practitioner in Wichita.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said her priorities include affordable healthcare, housing affordability and government accountability.

paragraphs.text: Amanda Mogoi graduated from Circle High School, earned a degree from Wichita Area Technical College in 2010, a bachelor's degree from Wichita State University in 2012 and a graduate degree from Walden University in 2016, according to Ballotpedia.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a nurse practitioner, small-business owner, nonprofit founder and mother who has been a nurse since 2010 and a nurse practitioner since 2016.
Mogoi advanced unopposed from the August 4, 2026 Democratic primary and faces Republican Al Jirak in the general election; no incumbent is seeking the seat.

She listed her campaign messages as making healthcare more affordable and accessible, helping working families afford housing and build financial security, and giving Kansans a stronger voice in government.
She said she supports expanding Medicaid, open primaries, direct citizen ballot measures and legislative term limits, and named water and natural resources among her interests.
She listed endorsements from the Sierra Club's Kansas Chapter, the LGBTQ+ Caucus of the Kansas Democratic Party and former Republican state Representative J.C. Moore.
